text:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F-1",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-07",
      "change_id": "CH-15",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-07 schedules Visit 8.1 at Day 91 with no visit window, whereas Table 1 (page 44) and Section 6.2.5 (page 51) specify Visit 8.1 is at Day 90 (480 hours after the Day 70 6th administration) with a ±2 day window."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-2",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-02",
      "change_id": "CH-15",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-02, OP-03, and OP-06 add PK subgroup visits V2.2, V2.3, and V7.3 without visit windows, omitting the ±1 day allowed visit windows specified in Table 1 (page 44) and the ±24 hour PK windows in Section 6.2.5 (page 51). Additionally, OP-01 through OP-07 cite a quote on page 51 that does not contain any of the target day numbers."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-3",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-08",
      "change_id": "CH-15",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-08 adds '48 h', '144 h', and '240 h' to the PKTPT codelist, but omits '480 h', which is required for the Day 90 (Visit 8.1) PK sample after the 6th dose (page 51)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-4",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-10",
      "change_id": "CH-15",
      "page": 37,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-10 triggers PK subgroup visits for all subjects who consent to the PK substudy at Randomisation ($V2.RAND.PKSUB = 'Yes'), whereas Section 4.2.2 (page 37) and Section 6.2.5 (page 51) state that only an electronically assigned subgroup of 24 patients in Mainland China enter the PK subgroup."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-5",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-12",
      "change_id": null,
      "page": null,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-12 updates the SDV100 review plan without citing any protocol page, quote, or change ID."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-6",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-16",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-13 through OP-16 create the new ADA form and assign it only to Visit 3, missing Visits 2, 4, 6, 8, and 9 where anti-TJ301 antibody blood sampling is also required per Table 1 (page 45) and Sections 6.2.3–6.3 (pages 50–52)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-7",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-20",
      "change_id": "CH-19",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-17 through OP-20 create the new DIARY form and assign it only to Visit 2, missing Visits 1, 1.1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8 where diary dispensing and/or diary review are required per Table 1 (page 44)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-8",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": "OP-21",
      "change_id": "CH-7",
      "page": 49,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "Inclusion Criterion 4 (page 34) and Table 1 footnote c (page 45) require screening endoscopy at Day -35 to Day -6 prior to Randomisation, whereas Section 6.2.2 (page 49) states 'Endoscopy conducted within 2 months before Randomisation is acceptable' and Table 1 footnote b (page 45) says 'within 35 days before Randomisation is acceptable'; it is ambiguous whether endoscopies outside Day -35 to Day -6 are permitted."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-9",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-22",
      "change_id": "CH-13",
      "page": 94,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-22 enforces an exact 2-hour infusion duration with zero tolerance ((EX.EXENDTC - EX.EXSTDTC) != 2h), contradicting the amendment rationale in Appendix 4 (page 94) which removed the '±3 min' tolerance specifically because it was too difficult for sites to control dosing time within ±3 minutes."
    }
  ],
  "overall_uncertainty": "Because the current casebook omits several protocol assessments (such as Physical Examination, Vital Signs, ECG, Clinical Labs, Biomarkers, and detailed Inclusion/Exclusion items) and does not define built-in references like $V2.DATE or days_between() argument ordering, I could not verify whether CH-9, CH-11, and CH-18 are handled externally or whether OP-21's date arithmetic evaluates with the intended sign."
}
